# One Outer Boundary

#### Course: React Beyond Basics

## One Outer Boundary

With a single outer boundary, every route shares one fallback.

```react
<Suspense fallback={<p>Loading...</p>}>
  <Routes>
    <Route path="/" element={<HomePage />} />
    <Route path="/entries/:id" element={<EntryDetailPage />} />
    <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundPage />} />
  </Routes>
</Suspense>
```

This is the simplest setup. It's fine for prototypes, but it limits how polished the loading experience can feel.

![One Outer Boundary](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Let's look at the alternative.
